title: Powerfleet Named AIoT Fleet Management Software Company of the Year 2026 by Transportation Outlook
summary: Recognition highlights Powerfleet's expertise, innovation, and customer impact WOODCLIFF LAKE, N.J., Oct. 15, 2026…...
body_markdown:
*Recognition highlights Powerfleet's expertise, innovation, and customer impact*


WOODCLIFF LAKE, N.J.


, Oct. 15, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Powerfleet, Inc. (Nasdaq: AIOT) (JSE: PWR), a global leader in the artificial intelligence of things (AIoT) software-as-a-service (SaaS) mobile asset industry, today announced that Transportation Outlook has selected it as the AIoT Fleet Management Software Company of the Year 2026.


The recognition reflects Powerfleet's organizational expertise, leadership, operational capabilities, technology initiatives, strategic direction, and contribution to the sector.


Powerfleet's Unity platform connects data across vehicles, assets, people, and enterprise systems, helping organizations translate fragmented operational information into actionable intelligence. This unified approach helps organizations improve safety, strengthen compliance, and increase efficiency across warehouses, yards, and on-road operations.


"Enterprises need connected intelligence to make faster, more informed decisions," said Steve Towe, Chief Executive Officer of Powerfleet. "With Unity, we're helping customers move from knowing what happened to understanding what needs to happen next and why - giving their teams the insight and AI tools to act with confidence and control. This recognition reflects our team's expertise and our commitment to turning AIoT innovation into sustained business value for our customers."


Headquartered in the US, Transportation Outlook has a global audience across transportation, mobility, fleet operations, infrastructure, logistics technology, and related business sectors. Its coverage examines industry developments, leadership, operational trends, and technologies shaping transportation. Subscriber nominations were reviewed by the publication's editorial committee, leading to Powerfleet being selected as the AIoT Fleet Management Software Company of the Year 2026.


**ABOUT POWERFLEET**


Powerfleet (Nasdaq: AIOT; JSE: PWR) provides AIoT software-as-a-service solutions for mobile assets and enterprise operations. By integrating and harmonizing data from diverse sources, Powerfleet delivers actionable intelligence that helps organizations improve safety, efficiency, and business performance. Headquartered in New Jersey, United States, the company operates globally, with a primary listing on The Nasdaq Global Market and a secondary listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
